description:
Add an axum middleware layer that requires 'Authorization: Bearer test-token' on every request (or whatever the --token CLI flag overrides it to; default 'test-token').

- 401 Unauthorized on missing or mismatched Authorization header.
- /.well-known/jmap MAY skip auth (discovery is sometimes unauthenticated; choose one and document the choice).
- /ws and /events require the token in either the Authorization header or as a query parameter (?token=...) for browsers that can't set Authorization headers on WebSocket / EventSource.
- Constant-time compare for the token using subtle::ConstantTimeEq::ct_eq (the workspace's secret-comparison policy applies — see jmap-chat-server's invite-code precedent at space.rs:601).

## Acceptance

- POST /jmap without Authorization → 401
- POST /jmap with wrong token → 401
- POST /jmap with right token → normal dispatch
- ws:// connections require the token
- SSE connections require the token
- cargo clippy clean (constant-time compare uses subtle, not ==)
- cargo test workspace clean

## Depends on .2 (router); can land in parallel with .3/.4/.5 since the auth layer wraps the whole router and is orthogonal to the per-endpoint logic.
title: Bearer auth middleware (hardcoded token, 401 on mismatch)
